html:
Here is some interesting news.

The Collège de Shawinigan is working on an astronomical observatory project in Mauricie National Park. Specifically located at the "le passage" rest stop, the observatory would serve the teaching needs of the educational institution.

Here is the text of the news article published in Le Nouvelliste.
